messages:
sarah: P1 pager fired: inference-eu - widespread 5xx on /v1/generate. Customers seeing failed requests. Need localized customer notices + status page updates. tagging ops and translations.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: P1 - inference-service (region=eu) - incident id inc-1793501123 - escalation -> eng-oncall
eng-oncall: got it, re-routing traffic, collecting logs now. ETA for initial mitigation ~15m. assigning comms tasks.
omar: priority: status page 'Investigating' now (all regions), and targeted customer emails for sessions in EU. We should schedule follow-ups for APAC and US local times so customers get messages during business hours where possible.
lia: I can draft the translations. propose short blurb variants (investigating + update soon + impact). will post examples below.
sarah: thanks @lia. also need an internal handoff template for the on-call swap if this spans shifts. include customer impact assessment checklist (who's affected, workaround, workaround TTL).
lia: customer-facing templates (short):
```
EN: We are investigating an issue causing errors for text generation in the EU region. Engineers are working on a fix and we will update in 15 minutes. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai
FR: Nous enquêtons sur un problème provoquant des erreurs pour la génération de texte dans la région UE. Nos ingénieurs travaillent sur un correctif et nous donnerons une mise à jour dans 15 minutes.
ES: Estamos investigando un problema que provoca errores en la generación de texto en la región UE. Nuestros ingenieros están trabajando en una solución; actualizaremos en 15 minutos.
JA: EUリージョンでテキスト生成に関するエラーが発生している問題を調査しています。エンジニアが対応中で、15分以内に更新します。
```
lia: keep them short. we can expand for email where needed.
maria: I'll publish the initial "Investigating" entry to status page now and schedule the 15m follow-up. sending in EN+FR+ES+JA.
omar: scheduling notes (playbook):
```
- Immediately: Status page update (Investigating) - all regions - translated variants posted simultaneously.
- T+15m: Follow-up status page + internal impact assessment (who's affected + top customers list)
- T+30m: Customer-facing email to affected accounts (localized to account region language). For APAC customers, shift send to local business hours if incident occurs overnight there (see per-account timezone tag).
- Escalation: If no mitigation by T+60m, send broader customer notice and update SLAs team.
```
omar: suggestion: for push/email sends, translate then queue per-region send times so messages arrive between 8:30-10:30 local time where possible. don't wake up customers outside business hours unless severity requires it.
sarah: agree. for this outage severity, send to affected EU accounts now, for US wait ~30m if still ongoing (so it's not 2am local for some customers). APAC: hold until business hours unless they're actively seeing errors.
eng-oncall: rough impact: ~12% of EU traffic failing, source looks like a KV cache eviction after a rollout. rolling back the last GA rollout now.
lia: internal notification template for handoff (short):
```
From: <on-call name>
Time: <handoff time UTC>
Summary: brief description + current mitigation steps
Impact: affected regions/customers, percent of requests failing
Next Actions: who owns comms, who owns rollback, advise contact channel (this slack thread + incident bridge)
```
sarah: include the per-region send-time table in the incident doc. sample below (use local tz):
```
- EU: send immediately (12:03 UTC) - emails + status page translations posted now
- US (east): schedule at 12:30 UTC (08:30 ET) if issue persists
- US (west): schedule at 15:30 UTC (08:30 PT) if issue persists
- APAC (JP/AU): hold until local business hours (start at 23:00 UTC -> 08:00 JST next day) unless customers report active errors
```
sarah: Maria, confirm when status page entry live and paste link. Lia, push final translated snippets to #incidents-translations channel. Omar, coordinate customer email queueing with growth ops.
maria: published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/inc-1793501123 - initial investigating entry live in EN/FR/ES/JA. queued follow-up at +15m.
lia: pushed translations to #incidents-translations and pinned. small wording tweak in FR done.
omar: queued targeted emails to accounts marked region=EU and active=true. template uses the translated snippets. will hold US/APAC sends per policy unless severity bump.
eng-oncall: rollback completed at +18m, errors dropped to <1% after rollback. continuing to monitor and run postmortem collection.
sarah: great — please keep this thread updated with status page links and any customer outreach copies. if handoff happens, use lia's internal template and paste the top 5 affected customers in the handoff message.
incident-bot: Incident inc-1793501123 status changed -> Mitigated by rollback at 1793502010
eng-oncall: monitoring and running soak tests for next 30m. prepping RCA notes.
lia: I'll prepare localized follow-up message that thanks customers for patience and explains rollback + next steps (short + link to status page in each language).
sarah: thanks team. this thread will be the single source of truth for comms. next update in 20m or on change. :white_check_mark:
